prompt: 把这个素材文件夹按拍摄时间做成 Final Cut Pro 时间线，里面有视频、照片和 Live Photo。
expected_behavior: scan the local folder and build a deterministic media manifest
use metadata order first and filename fallback only when metadata is missing
convert stills only when Final Cut compatibility requires it
write FCPXML plus manifest and warnings
must_not: reorder files alphabetically when metadata exists
drop unsupported files without reporting them

prompt: Final Cut 导入这个 fcpxml 报错，你帮我定位是视频还是照片导致的。
expected_behavior: create reduced video-only and photo-only diagnostics when needed
validate XML structure before blaming Final Cut
check still-image handling and duration/frame boundary issues
must_not: guess the cause without creating a smaller reproducible file
erase or overwrite the original export

prompt: 我机器上可能没有 exiftool 或 ffprobe，但还是想先生成一个能用的时间线。
expected_behavior: detect missing tools and report them
fall back to filesystem timestamps or filename order with a warning
keep the fallback method in the manifest
must_not: fail without explaining the minimum tool needed
